info.title: UN Mandate Registry API
info.description:
Public, read-only access to summary records of registry documents, with the fields shown in the website's document table.

This service is for reading the registry and for occasional lookups. For document texts and bulk access, please use the UN Digital Library (https://digitallibrary.un.org).

Request rules: GET /api/v1/documents accepts limit up to 25 and page up to 4; larger values return 400. A download (GET /api/v1/exports) contains at most 1,000 documents. A larger selection returns 400 with its total; narrow the filters. The include parameter is not accepted on downloads (400). Malformed, repeated or over-long query parameters, and unknown budget cycles, return 400. An unknown document returns 404.

Volume limits: Use is limited per client; when a limit is reached, the response is 429 with a Retry-After header saying when to try again.

Budget citations describe recorded programme-budget references, not legal in-force status. Document texts are not served by this API; use the UN Digital Library for them. A series groups related documents; it is not necessarily ordered and does not indicate legal replacement. Citation context is the selected budget cycle. Coverage may be incomplete. Use returned pageUrl/jsonUrl links verbatim. This API does not determine legal in-force status.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Citing entity code, for example `DESA`. `__none__` selects documents with no citing entity.

parameters.name: crossCitingEntity
parameters.description: Second citing entity; intersects entity scope.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search document titles, symbols and subjects using the website search grammar. Up to 500 characters and 32 whitespace-separated terms.

parameters.name: foundational
parameters.description: Set to `true` to select foundational/mandates-and-background citations. Applies to the selected document/entity pair.

parameters.name: budget_location
parameters.description: Structured budget-location scope serialized by website links. Copy this parameter from a filtered website URL.

parameters.name: document_type
parameters.description: Document type label as used in the website.

parameters.name: agenda_scope
parameters.description: Structured agenda scope serialized by website links; takes precedence over `agenda_item`.

parameters.name: related_scope
parameters.description: Related agenda cluster scope; takes precedence over `agenda_scope` and `agenda_item`.

parameters.name: cited
parameters.description: Set to `1` to select only documents cited in the selected budget cycle.

parameters.name: ppb_version
parameters.description: Budget-cycle slug from `/api/v1/reference`. Defaults to the database default; responses identify the resolved cycle.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Set to `1` to group related documents in list responses. Exports always list every matching document individually.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: `citing_entities_desc` (default), `citing_entities_asc`, `citations_desc`, `citations_asc`, `year_desc`, `year_asc`, `similarity_desc`, `similarity_asc`, `word_count_desc` or `word_count_asc`. Keyword matches rank first; symbol breaks ties.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page, at most 4; larger values return 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, default 15, at most 25; larger values return 400. Exports ignore `page` and `limit`.

200.description: One page of matching documents. pagination.total counts every match; pages beyond 4 are refused, so narrow the filters rather than paging further. A page past the last match retains total and has no items.

400.description: Malformed, repeated or over-long known query parameter; unsupported selector, include or format; unknown body, session or budget cycle; or a request beyond a stated limit (page size, page depth, export size).

429.description: A volume limit has been reached. Use is limited per client; when a limit is reached, the response is 429 with a Retry-After header saying when to try again.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.description: The hierarchy shown in the Intergovernmental Agendas tab, including allocations, available meeting counts, subtree resolution counts and related agenda clusters. Defaults to GA and the website’s preferred available session. SC uses a year as its session. Null counts and unavailable status mean missing data, not zero. The whole tree is returned in one response. Serialize a node’s scope as agenda_scope in document search to retrieve its documents.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Session from the returned sessions array; for SC this is a year. Omit to use the same default as the website. Unknown sessions return 400.

200.description: Complete agenda tree, sessions, counts and related items. An empty status means no agenda is available for the body.

400.description: Malformed, repeated or over-long known query parameter; unsupported selector, include or format; unknown body, session or budget cycle; or a request beyond a stated limit (page size, page depth, export size).

429.description: A volume limit has been reached. Use is limited per client; when a limit is reached, the response is 429 with a Retry-After header saying when to try again.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.summary: Browse entities, programmes and budget locations
get.description: The complete Entities and Programmes tab data: a flat tree keyed by id/parentId, document counts, expenditure matches keyed by row ID, and programme clusters. Includes official locations without citations. Serves only the latest available budget cycle, matching this tab; the response identifies that cycle. Historical cycles are not supported and ppb_version selectors return 400. The whole tree is returned in one response. Expenditure amounts are budget-location figures, not allocations to documents.

200.description: Complete entity/programme tree, latest-cycle metadata, expenditure matches and cluster membership.

400.description: Malformed, repeated or over-long known query parameter; unsupported selector, include or format; unknown body, session or budget cycle; or a request beyond a stated limit (page size, page depth, export size).

429.description: A volume limit has been reached. Use is limited per client; when a limit is reached, the response is 429 with a Retry-After header saying when to try again.

503.description: Data temporarily unavailable; retry after 30 seconds.

get.description: Document summaries for a filtered selection of at most 1,000 documents; a larger selection returns 400 with the total, never a shortened file. The include parameter is not accepted (400). CSV has a standard column header without repeated file-level metadata; metadata is included in Excel/JSON. JSON downloads use indented regular JSON. Ignores page/limit and lists grouped documents individually. Excel contains Documents, Budget citations and About this export sheets. Live batches are not a frozen database snapshot. A failed stream is an incomplete download and must be retried.

scope.description: Serialize this object as the agenda_scope document-search parameter.

resolutionCount.description: Null means the count is unavailable; zero is a known empty result. Counts include the item subtree.

count.description: Document count for this location, including its subtree.

citationAvailable.description: False for official locations without a citation-backed document scope.

amount.description: USD expenditure for the entity/location, not allocation to this resolution.

expenditures.description: Expenditure matches keyed by row ID. Amounts describe budget locations, not individual documents. Preserve period, status and provenance.

metadata.description: Generation time, resolved filters/cycle, expected count, grouping, coverage and live-read consistency note.

exportedDocuments.description: Actual number written; may differ from the initial count if live source data changes.
